//: Example .mcp.json for Claude Code (project scope). Copy it to your project root as .mcp.json.
No secrets here: ${VAR} is expanded by Claude Code from your environment, so set HARDSTOP_AGENT_KEY and HARDSTOP_VAULT in your shell.
HARDSTOP_AGENT_KEY is the AGENT's key. Never put the owner's key anywhere near an AI.
Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/hardstop with where you cloned the repository, and run `npm ci` in web/ once.
HARDSTOP_CHAIN_ID: 84532 (Base Sepolia, default) or 11155111 (Sepolia). Other chains are refused.
The second server, hardstop-demo, needs nothing: an in-memory network with a freshly launched vault.
